cohort: 164 preterm neonates (50 with IVH and 114 without IVH) admitted to a tertiary care NICU.
finding: Low gestational age, low birth weight, resuscitation at birth, birth from multiple pregnancies, and lack of antenatal steroids were associated with an increased risk of IVH, while lower segment cesarean section and a full course of antenatal steroids appeared to be protective.
